section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the relationship between femininity ideology and body appreciation among undergraduate women. The study found significant negative correlations between body appreciation and traditional femininity ideology scores, particularly with the Purity and Stereotypic Images and Activities subscales of the Femininity Ideology Scale (FIS). The authors note that their results represent an advance over previous literature by measuring femininity ideology rather than gender role orientation, though the associations were weak and explained only 10% of variance in body appreciation.
